# Offline transcription fixture

`goforward.flac` is a lossless FLAC conversion of the 16 kHz mono PCM fixture `test/data/goforward.raw` from [cmusphinx/pocketsphinx](https://github.com/cmusphinx/pocketsphinx/blob/main/test/data/goforward.raw), Git blob `350b76a92902e0580728fe675ee50753a383ffae`.

The spoken phrase is “go forward ten meters.” It tests real audio decoding and offline transcription without obtaining a user's microphone recording or calling an external service. The upstream license is included in `LICENSE.pocketsphinx`.
